skip.source_cn: 简单的检查后，佐尔娅弄清了吸血鬼休养的原理，建议你用魔法临时扩大魔力的传输效率，这是令苔佩希快速恢复的唯一办法。

en.text: After a brief examination, Zorya understands how vampires recover. She recommends temporarily improving the flow of magic, the only way to restore Tephesia quickly.
